title: Circular No. ( 10/6 /14992 ) dated 26/2/2019 about ATM instructions.
text:
Number: 10/6 /14992
Date: 7/4/1442 Hijri
Corresponding to 22/11/2020
Circular to licensed banks
After Greetings,,
With reference to the Automated Teller Machine Instructions No. (6/2018) on
11/4/2018, I decide to amend the provisions of Article (7) Clause (D) of these
instructions to become as follows:
"Printing the authorization number for the transaction that was performed
through the ATMs on the receipts extracted from it, or providing the
transaction authorization number to the customer through another appropriate
means, for example, but not limited to (online banking or by SMS)."
Respectfully,,
Governor
Dr. Ziad Fariz
